name: Koi wa Yumemiru Mouretsu Girl!
original_name: 恋は夢見る妄烈ガール！
source:
"Whatever the heck this is, it's sexy."

That first pang of love in one's heart is ever a sudden thing. That fiery passion I had felt towards my first love as a child, Yuunagi Shizuku, was revitalized as I  was suddenly thrust into a vivid erotic fantasy centering around her. And the reason I came back to the city from my childhood only to be suddenly assailed by erotic fantasies about my first love...?

The city Mioka sits below a shrine dedicated to cats. Due to his parents' work situation, a young man, Kujou Ren, who is considerate of others, or, in a word, is kind, ended up moving to this city. He stood, now, as a transfer student facing his new school, Mioka Academy, all the while remembering those two weeks he had spent in this town as a child, and the how he had fallen in the love for the first time in his life during those two weeks.

At it was on that first day, where, after heading home having left his classmates with a rather middling first impression of him, he would be granted a unique power as he was struck by lightning during the onset of a sudden rainstorm.

From henceforth, the moment a girl so happened to merely give him the briefest of touches, or he tripped and bumped into one on his way down, his mind would be forcibly filled with the erotic fantasies from the mind of whomever he touched. Such was the mysterious power he gained.

As a result of this new ability, he ends up becoming acquainted with many of his fellow classmates. He meets the slightly clumsy airhead Mioka Aoi, the daughter of the Shinto Priest of the Mioka Shrine and student council president, Nekojou Erika, as well as the boy-hating and energetic Shiozaki Yuki.

So it was that right after transferring to a new school, he found himself in the midst of an erotic and "fantastical" adolescence.

translation:
“不管这是什么，它都很性感。”

心中最初的爱意总是那么突然。我对儿时的初恋情人汤凪雫的那种炽热的热情又重新燃起，我突然陷入了以她为中心的生动的色情幻想中。为什么我从小回到城市，却突然被对初恋的色情幻想袭击……？

三冈市坐落在供奉猫的神社下方。由于父母的工作原因，一位为人着想，或者说是善良的年轻人九条莲最终搬到了这座城市。现在，他作为一名转校生，面对着新学校——三冈学园，他一直记得自己小时候在这个小镇度过的那两周，以及在那两周里他是如何第一次坠入爱河的。

就在第一天，他在同学们对他的第一印象相当一般的情况下回家后，却因一场突如其来的暴雨而被闪电击中，从而获得了一种独特的力量。

从此以后，只要有一个女孩碰巧轻轻地触碰了他一下，或者是他下楼的时候绊了一下，撞到了一个女孩，他的脑海里就会强行充满被他触碰的人的色情幻想。这就是他获得的神秘力量。

由于这种新能力，他最终结识了许多同学。他结识了三冈神社神官之女、学生会长猫城绘里香，略显笨拙的傻瓜三冈葵，以及讨厌男孩、精力充沛的盐崎由纪。

就这样，刚转学到新学校，他就发现自己正处于一个情色和“幻想”的青春期。
